description: Open any .md file and read it beautifully — on your iPhone, iPad, or Mac. Read.md is a markdown reader. Not an editor, not a note-taking app, not a vault system. A reader. Tap a .md file, it opens, it looks great, you read it. PERFECT RENDERING Tables, code blocks, nested lists, task lists, blockquotes, images, links — everything renders correctly. Syntax highlighting for 180+ programming languages. GitHub Flavored Markdown fully supported. MERMAID DIAGRAMS Flowcharts, sequence diagrams, Gantt charts, class diagrams, and more render natively. Tap to zoom into any diagram for a detailed view. EXPORT TO WORD, PDF & HTML Turn any document into a real Word (.docx) file with proper headings, tables, lists and code blocks, a clean, paginated, print-quality PDF, or a self-contained HTML file — diagrams and images intact. Share it, print it, archive it. Or export the original Markdown source. (Word, PDF and HTML export are Read.md Pro; Markdown export is free.) OPEN FROM GITHUB Read documentation straight from the source. Browse any GitHub repository — public or private — navigate its file tree, and open any .md file with the same beautiful rendering. Sign in with a personal access token; your token stays on your device. (Read.md Pro) SMART DIAGRAM FIXER ASCII art and box-drawing diagrams that look broken in other apps? Read.md detects and corrects misaligned characters automatically so your diagrams look the way they were intended. NAVIGATE LONG DOCUMENTS Auto-generated table of contents from your headings. Search within any document with match highlighting and next/prev navigation. Your scroll position is remembered when you come back to a file. ZERO FRICTION No account needed to read. No workspace. No vault. No setup. Works as your default .md file handler — open markdown and plain-text files from Files, Finder, email attachments, AirDrop, the share sheet, or drag and drop. ADAPTS TO YOUR DEVICE iPhone: stacked navigation with a frosted-glass nav bar and bottom sheets. iPad: landscape split-view, portrait slide-over panels, trackpad and keyboard support. Mac: split-view with sidebar, reader, and table-of-contents panel, keyboard shortcuts, and translucent panels. Everything adapts automatically when you resize windows or rotate your device. DARK AND LIGHT MODES Switch between dark and light themes, or follow your system setting. Adjust font size to your preference. Everything updates live. PRIVATE BY DESIGN Opens instantly, even large files. Your markdown is rendered entirely on your device — file contents are never uploaded, and reading works fully offline. No ads. No account required to read. The only feature that touches the network is GitHub browsing, and only when you choose to use it. We use anonymous, aggregate analytics to improve the app. READ.MD PRO A one-time purchase — or a yearly subscription with a free trial — unlocks Word/PDF/HTML export and GitHub browsing. Everything else stays free, forever. WHAT PEOPLE USE IT FOR Reading AI-generated markdown exports. Turning markdown into Word documents for colleagues. Reading GitHub README files on mobile. Viewing documentation and project specs on the go. Reviewing technical docs from colleagues. Browsing personal notes written in markdown. description: Ulysses is your one-stop writing environment for Mac, iPhone and iPad. Its pleasant, focused writing experience, combined with effective document management, seamless sync, and flexible export, make Ulysses the first choice for writers of all kinds. ++ Apple Design Award Winner ++ “The app is amazing. An absolute delight to use. Well done.” – David Hewson, Bestselling Author (The Killing) ### A Text Production Powerhouse Ulysses’ markup-based, distraction-free editor lets you focus on your most important task: Write, edit, and write some more. Formatting is kept for later, so you can completely immerse yourself in the text. Ulysses’ uniquely streamlined toolset covers the entire writing process, and its clean and simple interface will boost your productivity. From first to final draft, from prologue to closing chapter – Ulysses keeps you in the flow, so you can get stuff done. ### All Your Texts, All the Time Everything you’ll ever write is stored in Ulysses’ unified library. You can manage projects of all kinds and sizes, be it novels, diaries or study notes – they are always saved, and automatically in sync. And since Ulysses offers feature parity across macOS and iOS, it doesn’t matter where you are or when inspiration hits: All its tools, and all your texts, are always at your fingertips. ### Built-In Proofreader and Editing Assistant Write with confidence, thanks to Ulysses’ integrated grammar and style check. Available for over 20 languages, it analyzes your text and offers informed suggestions for capitalization, punctuation, semantics, redundancy, style and more. ### Create eBooks, DOCX, PDFs and HTML Ulysses’ export is flexible enough to cover any writer’s needs: Transform your text into beautiful PDFs, Word documents or eBooks. Or export HTML code, ready to be used anywhere on the web. You can even choose between a variety of pre-made formatting styles for all kinds of purposes, or create your own and share it with other users. ### Publish to WordPress, Ghost, Substack & More Do you blog? Ulysses’ offers best-in-class publishing to WordPress, Ghost, and Micro.blog. You can post to WordPress, Ghost and Micro.blog from right within the app – complete with images, tags, categories etc. All offer a built-in preview to proofread before submission. Ulysses also supports copy paste publishing to Substack and Basecamp. ### Pricing Ulysses requires a subscription. We offer monthly and yearly subscription plans. They include a fully functional trial, so you can test Ulysses (including export and sync). There’s also a special discount for students. All plans unlock the app on Mac, iPhone and iPad, and feature full synchronization. ### Questions Please visit ulysses.app for more information. You can also reach us via help@ulysses.app or on Twitter @ulyssesapp – we’re happily awaiting your feedback! description: MWeb was born in 2015. It is a writing, note-taking and publishing app focusing on Markdown. If you like Markdown or text writing, We highly recommend you try MWeb. MWeb is composed of a complete and stable editor, a Folders mode for managing documents, a Library mode specifically for notes, and a document publishing and sharing function set, with a total of four modules. The feature of MWeb's software is that it chooses platform-native technology for each platform. It is built using AppKit on macOS and UIKit on iOS/iPadOS. The following is a brief introduction to these four modules. If you are interested, you can continue reading. ## Editor features Here are some of the key features of an editor: * Base on CommonMark syntax and GitHub Flavored Markdown (GFM) extended syntax, supporting TOC, tables, code blocks, math formulas, task lists, footnotes, etc. * Display the text of the Markdown document completely without any deletion. * Images can be displayed directly in the Editor, supporting jpg, png, gif, webP, HEIC and etc. * Math formulas, mermaid and Echarts drawings can be previewed in the editor. * You can set your favorite font or multiple fonts for writing. * You can choose from 11 light themes and 21 dark themes, and also support custom themes. * There is a menu to facilitate the input of Markdown syntax, and a special Markdown syntax keyboard is also provided in iOS. * Convenient tools for generating and formatting Markdown table syntax. * You can view the outline and word count of Markdown documents. * Markdown documents can be previewed and support Editor & Preview mode. ## Folders mode The first requirement of Markdown is to create and edit Markdown documents, and MWeb's Folders mode does this. It supports the following features: * Create Markdown, Textbundle documents, or simply open them for editing. * Introduce a folder with Markdown documents into the Folders mode of MWeb. MWeb will provide practical functions such as management of Markdown documents, full-text search, copy and paste to insert images, and unified storage of referenced images. * iPadOS/iOS version supports Dropbox folders. ## Library mode Markdown is so easy to use, so taking notes is also in great demand. Of course, you can use Folders mode and introduce a folder to take notes, which is also very nice and easy to share. So why do we still create a separate Library mode? Mainly, the Library mode has the following features: * There is no need to consider the file name, title and storage location, Just create note and writing. * Use category trees and tags to manage notes. A single note can be classified into multiple categories, making it easier to set categories for notes. * Organizing notes is more convenient. When moving categories and notes, renaming categories will not affect each other. You don't need to worry about incorrect associations between notes, incorrect reference location of images and attachments in notes, etc. * Complete cross-device synchronization using iCloud CloudKit technology. * The Library follows the "local first" principle and is stored in a folder, very easy for backup. Even if you use iCloud sync, your Library can be completely backed up locally. * Export the entire category of notes to PDF or Epub e-book. * The macOS version of MWeb Pro also supports generating static blogs from categories. The generated blog fully supports math formulas, mermaid, echarts etc. Allows you to create your own blog in a very simple way. ## More features... * Publish documents or notes to Wordpress, Metaweblog API, Evernote, Blogger, Tumblr, Yuque, sspai Matrix, Ghost and Medium. * Upload images in documents or notes to imgur, Qiniu, SM.MS, Tencent COS, Youpai, Alibaba OSS, custom API, etc. * Export documents or notes to PDF (with Table of Contents in macOS version). * Export documents or notes to Epub or image. Privacy Policy: https://www.mweb.im/policy.html Terms of Use: https://www.mweb.im/terms.html Hope you enjoy MWeb!

description: Read Markdown (R.md) is the fast, lightweight way to read and edit Markdown on iPhone and iPad. Open a .md file and it appears instantly, rendered exactly like GitHub, in a clean, distraction free layout. Need to change something? Tap the pencil and edit, with a formatting bar right above the keyboard. Truly native, no accounts, no setup, no internet. WHY READ MARKDOWN • Fast: opens in a blink and scrolls smoothly, even for big documents. • Lightweight: a tiny native app that is easy on memory and battery. • Dead simple: just open a file and read. Nothing to configure. READING • Renders like GitHub, including tables, task lists and blockquotes. • Syntax highlighting for code blocks, with a copy button on each one. • Live Mermaid diagrams: flowcharts and sequence diagrams render in the page. • Dark mode that follows your system appearance. • Live outline: tap a heading to jump, or filter to find one. On iPad it stays open in a sidebar. • Images next to your document and links to other .md files just work. • Find in page, adjustable text size, and a list of recent files. • Export a clean, paginated A4 PDF and share it anywhere. EDITING • Reading stays reading: the app only switches to editing when you tap the pencil. • On iPad, edit side by side with a live preview that updates as you type. • Formatting bar for headings, bold, italic, code, links, lists, checklists and tables, plus undo and redo. • Smart typing: Return continues lists, code fences close themselves, and pasting a URL over selected text makes a link. • Tick a checkbox right in the rendered page and the change is saved to your file. • Light syntax colors in the editor, a clear unsaved indicator, and a prompt before you close. • Plays well with other apps: changes made elsewhere are detected, and you choose to reload or keep yours. • Hardware keyboard shortcuts on iPad: Cmd+B, Cmd+I, Cmd+K and Cmd+S. WORKS WITH YOUR FILES Open documents from the Files app, iCloud Drive or any other app with Open In. Files are edited in place, so nothing is copied or uploaded. Works fully offline. No account, no tracking, and your files never leave your device. Perfect for developers, writers and anyone who reads README files, design docs and notes. Download Read Markdown and open your first .md file in seconds.

description: > Trusted by more than 200K users. > Featured as "Be the First to Try These Apps" and "Hot This Week" by Apple. > Featured by well-known media like iMore and MacStories. # Taio A modern app for text processing on iPhone, iPad, and Mac, provides seamless experience for clipboard, markdown editing and text workflows. Taio supports Universal Purchase, pay once to use on iPhone, iPad and Mac devices. ## Main Features ### Clipboard Taio takes clipboard data as one of the input sources, you can capture it quickly for *temporary* use. Saved records can be synchronized across your iOS devices using iCloud, we also provide beautiful home screen widgets for better experience. ### Editor Taio provides a full-fledged **Markdown** editor, it supports `CommonMark` and `GitHub Flavored` standards. Instead of telling you everything, we would like to highlight some great stuff here: - Full text search, in-document search - Built-in image uploading - Focus mode - Multi-Tab editing - Multiple color themes - Toolbar for beginners - Outline view - Math formulas and diagrams - Tags, wikilinks and backlinks - Export to multiple formats - Dynamic text in snippets - Open file system that can be accessed by other apps - Syntax highlighting for common programming languages There are more interesting features we cannot cover here, please try it out! ### Actions Text actions in Taio is a powerful mechanism to provide extensibility for both **clipboard** and **editor**, it works the same as the `Shortcuts` app. You can build your own workflows using several action blocks, with support for variables and control flows. Furthermore, if the built-in actions don't meet your needs, you can even write action blocks using **JavaScript**. The JavaScript engine in Taio is powered by JSBox, it provides tons of API bindings to interact with iOS. ## Customer Support Feel free to reach us out if you have any suggestions or ideas. - Website: https://taio.app - Email: hi@taio.app - Twitter: @TaioApp Privacy policy: https://docs.taio.app/#/privacy Terms of service: https://docs.taio.app/#/terms Thank you so much for reading this, we hope you enjoy using our app!

description: SteelNote is a notes app built on one promise: your notes are plain Markdown files that you own. Every note is a real .md file on your device, openable in the Files app or in any editor you like, today and years from now. No proprietary database. Nothing locked away. Your notes, truly yours. Because every note is plain text, you are never trapped. Read and edit them in SteelNote, in Files, or in any other Markdown app. If you ever move on, you take your files with you as they are, in an open format that lasts. Native on all your Apple devices. SteelNote is built natively for iPhone, iPad and Mac. Your notes sync across all of them through iCloud, with no third party account and no extra sign in. Start a note on your phone and finish it on your Mac. Find anything, instantly. A local full text index makes search immediate, even in large libraries. Link notes together, see backlinks, organize with folders and tags, and turn any line into a task. Private when you want it. Mark a note as private and it stays out of widgets and AI features. Your most sensitive notes remain yours alone. Bring everything with you. Import from Bear, Notion, Obsidian and Evernote, or from Markdown, TextBundle, Word, RTF, PDF and CSV files. Your folders and structure come along. Apple Notes works too, one note at a time, because Apple offers no bulk export. Everything you expect. Add images, PDFs and tables inline. Use checklists, footnotes and links. Reach your notes from Spotlight, Siri and widgets, and hand off between devices. An open format, now standard. Markdown is a first class type across Apple platforms, and SteelNote is built natively around it. Your files are open, portable and yours. Membership. SteelNote comes with a 14 day free trial, then a yearly plan or a one time lifetime purchase. You can cancel during the trial and pay nothing, or skip the subscription and choose the lifetime purchase instead. Sync is always included and never restricted. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. A yearly plan renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. description: Turn any document into clean, portable Markdown or plain text, right on your Mac. Smart Document Detection ‣ Recognizes agreements, invoices, bank statements, financial reports and manuals, and formats them accordingly when it's confident. Preview, Edit and Export ‣ See the result before saving and edit it right in the app. ‣ Drag and drop whole folders or mix file types in one batch. ‣ Existing files are never overwritten. Watch Folder ‣ Pick a folder and every new file dropped into it is converted automatically, even after you close the window. Finder Quick Action ‣ Right-click any supported file in Finder and choose "Convert to Markdown". No need to open the app. Shortcuts ‣ Use File2Text actions in your shortcuts and automations, or run them from Terminal. Private by Design ‣ All processing happens on your Mac. ‣ No uploads, no tracking, no accounts, no internet required. Available in 18 languages. WHO IT'S FOR • Developers: feed Markdown into Git, docs or static sites. • AI and data teams: prepare clean text for LLMs, RAG and training data. • Researchers and students: quote and annotate without retyping. • Accountants and finance teams: turn statements and reports into searchable text. • Lawyers and compliance teams: archive agreements in a diff-friendly format. • Writers and publishers: turn EPUB and Kindle books into editable drafts. • Anyone who hates copying and pasting from PDFs. SUPPORTED FORMATS ‣ Documents: PDF, DOC, DOCX, DOCM, DOTX, RTF, RTFD, TXT, MD, HTML, MHT ‣ Presentations: PPTX, PPTM, PPSX, POTX ‣ Spreadsheets: CSV, TSV, XLSX, XLSM, XLTX ‣ eBooks (DRM-free): EPUB, MOBI, AZW, AZW3 ‣ Images with OCR: PNG, JPG, TIFF, HEIC, BMP, GIF, WEBP and more ‣ Email, Contacts and Calendars: EML, VCF, ICS ‣ Notebooks and Subtitles: IPYNB, SRT, VTT ‣ Source Code: Swift, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Java, Go, Rust, C, C++ and more ‣ Data and Config: JSON, XML, YAML, PLIST, SQL, INI, CFG, CONF, PROPERTIES, LOG FREE TO TRY Convert one file at a time and one-page PDFs for free, and preview longer documents in full. description: Lockbook is an end-to-end encrypted notes app for writing, sketching, storing files, syncing across devices, and collaborating in real time. Your notes are encrypted before they leave your device, so even we can't read them. Lockbook is 100% open source: https://github.com/lockbook/lockbook Fast & Native: We built Lockbook for everyday use because we use Lockbook every day. Our native apps feel at home on every platform, with fast sync, offline support, and a polished Markdown editor for serious notes. Secure: Keep your thoughts to yourself. Lockbook encrypts your notes with keys generated on your devices. Only you and the people you share with can access your notes, folders, sketches, and files. Private: Know your customer? We sure don't. We don't collect your email, phone number, or name. We don't need a password. Lockbook is for people with better things to worry about than privacy. Collaborative: Share folders, edit notes together, and see live updates from collaborators without giving up end-to-end encryption. Open: Write in Markdown, sketch in SVG, and keep your work in formats you can actually use. Honest: Be the customer, not the product. We sell a note-taking app, not your data. Developer Friendly: The Lockbook CLI fits right into your favorite chain of piped-together Unix commands. Search your notes with fzf, edit them with vim, and schedule backups with cron. When scripting doesn't cut it, use our Rust library for a robust programmatic interface. (Pro) • Backups of your whole library: a dated zip archive with your version history inside, offered when one is due, while the app is open, in a folder you pick. (Pro) YOUR FILES, YOUR RULES • Unlimited documents, as plain .md files you can open anywhere. • Folders, color labels and tags, with search that filters by tag. • iCloud Drive sync between iPhone, iPad and Mac, with no setup. • External folders: work directly inside any folder on your device or in iCloud Drive. (Pro) INKIOSTRO PRO — ONE PURCHASE, EVERY DEVICE One purchase unlocks Pro on iPhone, iPad and Mac, forever. Try it free for 7 days. • The visual editor • Version history with search, comparison and a year of versions • Backups of your library • Professional ePub, HTML, and books made of many files • PDF page setup • Focus and Typewriter modes • External folders • 24 app themes, the Pro preview styles and any font installed on your device MADE FOR • Writers: novels and essays in plain text, out as a real ebook • Students and researchers: notes and theses with proper formulas • Developers: READMEs, documentation and technical notes with diagrams • Anyone tired of paying every month for a text editor • Anyone new to Markdown: the visual editor works like a word processor PRIVACY Your documents stay in your iCloud Drive or on your device. description: MDReader opens your Markdown files and folders and renders them properly. There is no library to import into, no account to create and no sync service in the middle. Your .md files stay exactly where you put them, and MDReader reads and writes them in place. FAST, EVEN ON BIG FILES A two-tier parser scans a document in a single pass and only fully parses the blocks you can actually see. All conversion happens entirely on your device.

description: Marko is a fast, native Markdown reader for iPhone and iPad. Open any .md file and read it the way it was meant to look, with real typography, syntax-highlighted code, GFM tables and task lists, Mermaid diagrams, and KaTeX math. Everything renders on your device with no network access, so your documents never leave it. Marko is a reader, not an editor. It never changes your files. Open Markdown straight from the Files app, or share it in from Mail, Safari, or any other app, and read it full-screen with an outline, find in page, and adjustable text size. It is built for the Markdown you didn't write by hand, too: the .md that AI assistants and coding agents produce, generated READMEs, and agent output. LISTEN TO ANY DOCUMENT Read Aloud speaks the rendered document and highlights each sentence as it goes, so you can follow along or put the phone down. Start anywhere with Read from Here, adjust the speaking rate, and control it from the Lock Screen. Ask Siri to read a document and it starts hands-free. DOCUMENT INTELLIGENCE, ON DEVICE Summarize a long document, ask questions about it, or explain a selected passage. Marko can explain a Mermaid diagram too, reading the diagram itself. All processed on your device with Apple Intelligence. Nothing is sent to a server. (Requires iOS 26 or later on a device with Apple Intelligence. Explaining diagrams requires iOS 27.) TRANSLATE WITHOUT LEAVING THE PAGE Translate a document into another language in place, then switch back to the original. On device, offline, once the language is downloaded. (Requires iOS 26.4 or later.) PICK UP WHERE YOU STOPPED Marko remembers where you were in every document. For documents in iCloud Drive, that position follows you to your other devices, and Handoff moves the document itself between iPhone, iPad, and Mac. ON YOUR HOME SCREEN A Continue Reading widget shows the page you left off on and takes you straight back to it. A Recent Documents widget lists what you have been reading. Spotlight and Shortcuts can find your documents by name. HIGHLIGHTS - Native Swift and SwiftUI app for iPhone and iPad. Not a web app. - Renders fully offline. Your documents never leave your device. - Opens Markdown in place from Files, and via the share sheet from other apps. - Read Aloud with follow-along highlighting and a speaking-rate control. - On-device summarize, ask, and explain, including diagrams. - Outline, find in page, and text zoom. - Light, Dark, and System themes. - The same app on iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Marko collects no data. It has no analytics, no accounts, and makes no network requests of its own. Free. Requires iOS or iPadOS 18 or later.

description: Open .md files on iPhone, iPad, or Mac, or paste raw Markdown from a social post or chat. MarkLook turns it into a clear, beautifully typeset document for reading. MarkLook stores no files, offers no editor, requires no account, and has no monthly subscription. It is made for reading. On iPhone and iPad, choose an .md file from the Files app or paste Markdown from the clipboard. On Mac, open files from Finder, Quick Look, or the Open With menu. --- FIND YOUR FAVORITE READING VIBE --- To cater to different reading habits and aesthetic preferences, we offer several built-in themes. For each theme, we've fine-tuned the typography, font sizes, and line spacing to ensure reading is effortless, while specifically optimizing the visual balance when mixing English and non-English text. We have prepared several built-in appearances (themes) for you: • Default: The cleanest, foundational system font typography. • Essay: Looks like a meticulously typeset book, perfect for reading long articles. • Typewriter: Recreates the monospace texture of a typewriter, bringing back classic manuscript styling. • Notebook: A rounded, soft notebook style. • GitHub: The classic style familiar to all programmers. All built-in themes support Dark Mode. If you are a loyal Typora user, you can also directly import your commonly used Typora theme packages (.zip or .css formats) to continue your most familiar reading experience. --- OPTIMIZED MOBILE READING EXPERIENCE --- Reading documents on mobile devices is often constrained by the system environment or narrow screen layouts. MarkLook has made targeted optimizations: • Folder Browsing: Add a folder to browse Markdown and TextBundle documents from it and its subfolders in one place, with search by file name, path, or content. • One-Tap Local Image Authorization: Due to iOS sandbox restrictions, apps cannot read external images by default. With a simple one-tap authorization of your document directory, images in your text appear instantly. • Immersive Image Preview: Tap an image to go full-screen. Supports pinch-to-zoom and swipe gestures, allowing you to see every detail clearly even on a limited screen. • Smooth Wide Table Scrolling: Optimized algorithms for narrow screens ensure complex tables are no longer crowded or distorted. Supports horizontal scrolling to view complete data, keeping the text looking as it should. --- COMPREHENSIVE ADVANCED FEATURE SUPPORT --- Beyond basic syntax, the following contents are also well-supported: • Code Highlighting: Supports 180+ programming languages with clear logical presentation. • Math Equations: Flawless support for LaTeX math, rendering even complex formulas quickly and elegantly. • Flowcharts & Diagrams: Supports Mermaid flowcharts and sequence diagrams, which can be enlarged for full-screen viewing. --- ONE-TIME PURCHASE, NO SUBSCRIPTIONS --- The app offers both a free and a full version. The "Default" theme is completely free with a clean interface. When you try out other built-in themes, a subtle upgrade prompt will appear at the bottom of the preview page. If you desire a more refined and pure experience, consider a one-time purchase to unlock the full version (no subscriptions, no ads): • Unlock All Built-in Themes: Switch freely between your favorite typography styles without any prompt bars. • Unlock Typora Theme Import: Bring in your custom community theme packages (.zip or .css formats). One-time purchase, universal for iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Simply tap "Restore Purchase" on your other device. We hope to provide you with a quiet, comfortable little tool for reading. If you happen to read Markdown files frequently, welcome to give it a try.

description: Caliu is a quiet place to write. Open it and start typing: no account, no setup, no clutter. Markdown takes shape as you type, everything works offline, and your notes stay on your device. When you want them everywhere, create a free account and they follow you across iPhone, iPad, Mac and the web. Sync is free, and it stays free. Writing comes first Headings, lists, tasks, quotes, code and links format as you write. There is no preview pane and no mode to switch: what you see is your note. The interface steps aside and leaves you with the page. Organised the way you think Tags instead of folders, because one idea can belong in many places. Nest them, colour them, and find any note in seconds. Link notes to each other and follow a thought from one to the next. Pin what matters now, and archive what you are done with without losing a word. There when you need it Native on iPhone, iPad and Mac, with a web app for everything else. Put a reminder on any note and Caliu nudges you on whichever device you pick up. Save things to Caliu straight from the share sheet, or add a thought from your Apple Watch. Yours, and only yours No ads. No tracking. Nothing you write is used to train AI. Your notes live on your device first and sync encrypted, and Caliu is built in the EU under GDPR. Export any note as Markdown or plain text whenever you like, share one as a public link when someone needs to read it, and delete your account at any time. Deleted means deleted. For tinkerers A full REST API and a built-in MCP server, so Claude, Cursor or your own scripts can read and write your notes, on your terms. Your first API key is free. Caliu Pro Writing, tags, sync and working offline are free, with no limits on notes. Caliu Pro is for when you want more: • Voice dictation that turns speech into clean Markdown, filler words trimmed • Version history: scroll back through any note and restore it in a tap • Every theme, font and app icon: 22 colour themes, each in light and dark, and 30 fonts • Drawing, right inside your notes • Unlimited attachments • More export formats: HTML, ePub, PDF, RTF and TextPack • Unlimited API keys, and connecting AI apps like Claude to your notes Try it free before you decide. Caliu Pro is an auto-renewing subscription: it renews unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and you can manage or cancel it anytime in your App Store account settings. Made with care by a small, independent team of one. Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ Privacy Policy: https://caliuapp.com/privacy

description: uFocus is a distraction-free writing environment that supports plain text files and allows you to keep them organized inside libraries. You can then export your documents to HTML or PDF. With CriticMarkup and Live Edit Mode you can easily mark removals, additions and substitutions, add highlghts and comments, and accept or reject them. • Fountain: create screenplays with the Markdown-inspired markup syntax and print or export them as PDF with industry-standard formatting. • Highlighting: you can stay even more focused by fading out all the text but the current sentence or paragraph. • Typewriter scrolling: automatically scrolls the text when you get on a new line. • Sound mode: experience the ultimate feeling of a typewriter. • No deletions mode: disable deletions and replacements if your greatest temptation is always to edit your text instead of writing. • Fullscreen: focus on your words and hide everything else. • Choose between three different editor widths, four font sizes and a light, dark, sepia or amber theme, or create your own theme. • Print single files or entire directory hierarchies. If you have any requests, suggestions or bug reports, you're welcome to visit the website through the Support link.

description: Metion is a notebook tool that focuses on the writing experience, uses Markdown as basic text syntax. ## Build Your Own Knowledge Base Metion 2.0 brings a new feature named "Knowledge Base", the plain text syntax, then becomes mindmap trees, or connected as a network... ## The Writing Experience is So Important Our goal is to create a great writing experience, specially for iPadOS, although it's not easy. Metion provides a relatively complete keyboard shortcuts support. After a keyboard connected, both iPad and iPhone can archive a huge improvement in writing experience. We also have redesigned the "Zen Mode" on iPad, a more focusing writing mode. It is very very beautiful, choosing a suitable background image, selecting the white noise you like in Zen Mode, and the irrelevant UI elements are hidden. Writing is a pleasure, writing is talking to the world, writing is your Zen. ## Data Freedom, Open Filesystem, Git Built-in Metion based on the open filesystem, no need to create another new format for storing data. An article is a plain text file, and the images in the article are also under a certain folder. Data freedom and open filesystems allow us to synchronize data across devices using iCloud or Git. If you have a higher requirement for data security, you can also make a backup very quickly by copying the entire folder (working directory). One more thing, Metion has a built-in support named "history version" that provides a little more reliability for your documents. **Also, if you know how to use Git, you can try Git to sync. Yes! We have the powerful Git as a built-in feature! ** ## Optimized for iPad Pro, Also for iPhone We tried the best to make Metion optimized for iPad Pro, when writing on iPad Pro by Metion, the iPad is a really more productive device. Metion is also optimized for the iPhone too. In recent years, most of the new iPhones have notch at the top of screen. Metion does not simply avoid the safe area, but makes a lot of technical efforts to apply every pixel on the screen as far as possible. If using the visual theme of "Dark", the notch sometimes look like disappeared, like the next generation of full-screen phone comes. ## The Exporting of Metion If using Metion to export as PDF, we suggest the theme of PDF can be set as "Printer" in Settings Panel. If there is a real printer connected in current local network, just print directly, it will be pretty when words on the real paper. Document in Metion can be exported as image, which is optimized for mobile device (iPhone). We can set text and QR-Code signature at the end of exported image. Send it to friends through some social Apps. The beautiful layout of text can highlight the value of your words. Metion can analyze the structure of current article automatically, then export it as "Mindmap" with one tap only. - - - - - - - - - - Privacy Policy: http://markeditor.com/privacy-policy.html Terms of Use: http://markeditor.com/page/terms.md

description: Write Markdown, inspect the document as a system, and publish a finished file without sending the text to a server. FrankenMarkdown keeps the source and rendered document together. Multi-chapter projects can produce a continuous PDF or a self-contained site package. Export the current document as PDF or self-contained HTML. The bundled Rust rendering engine handles typography, tables, code, mathematical notation, and document structure locally. No account, advertising, tracking, or cloud processing is required. Your text stays on the device unless you choose to share an exported file.

description: md Viewer opens Markdown files, shows them cleanly formatted right away, and lets you edit that same text in place, create new documents, and save them back to the file. No file browser. No account. No cloud. No tracking. Open a .md or .txt file from the Files app or the share menu. md Viewer renders headings, lists, tables, bold/italic, code blocks with syntax highlighting, and quotes. No raw text, no characters to decode. CREATE, EDIT, SAVE Start without a file: tap Paste on the start screen to take text from the clipboard, or choose Blank Document. The draft opens straight in the editor. The red checkmark saves it as a new .md file; you pick the folder and name in the Files dialog. After that, the checkmark writes to that same file as usual. Existing files: tap Edit in the top right. The preview turns into a text editor. Save with the red checkmark; after a short confirmation the original file is overwritten. The X discards your changes (after a confirmation), and the arrow steps back through individual changes. No autosave, no export, no second copy. .txt files open in the app and in the share extension too. When you edit a .txt, the app also offers Save as Markdown. If you only want to read, none of this gets in the way. Every file opens in the formatted preview first. WHY SO MINIMAL? Most Markdown apps today are full editors with file management, cloud sync, and menus. Handy, but too much when you just want to read a file quickly, jot down a quick note, or fix a typo now and then. md Viewer deliberately does only that: tap a file, read, change or create if needed, done. FEATURES - Open via Open With in the Files app or straight from the share menu (mail attachments, AirDrop). The share extension shows the document formatted right away, without switching apps - Create a new document from pasted or typed text and save it as a .md file - Opens .md and .txt - Keep several documents open at once: as tabs on iPad, via the Open Documents list on iPhone. Open files come back after a restart - Find in the document with the magnifying glass or ⌘F, plus Find and Replace while editing - Clean Markdown rendering: headings, lists, task lists, tables (scroll horizontally), code blocks with syntax highlighting, quotes, links, images - Edit and save in place in the open file, with a confirmation before overwriting and before closing with unsaved changes - Full Unicode support: emoji, Arabic and Hebrew (right-to-left), Chinese, Japanese, and Korean characters - Supports Dynamic Type and VoiceOver - Automatic Dark Mode / Light Mode - Runs entirely offline: md Viewer loads nothing from the internet, not even images PRIVACY md Viewer collects no data at all. No analytics, no tracking, no account, no cloud sync. Files you open, edit, and create are processed only locally on your device. Only your open documents and folders allowed for images are remembered, locally, and you can remove either at any time. The clipboard is read only when you explicitly tap Paste. Who is it for? Anyone who regularly receives or manages .md or .txt files (notes, READMEs, technical docs, meeting notes) and wants to read them quickly and cleanly, edit them now and then, or jot down a new one, without opening a full editor.

description: A hypernotebook built around Markdown/CommonMark, with 1Password integration, HTML/CSS/Bootstrap support, live task lists, smart drag-n-drop insertion, multiple themes, document aliasing, and more. Taking notes, writing blog articles, managing all the technical details of your websites and projects -- these are just some of the things _Versatil Markdown_ can be used for. ## Feature Overview ### Display First Meaning if you're not editing the text, then it's being displayed rendered, making it easy to read and reference. ### Markdown/CommonMark Syntax Built on the emerging _CommonMark_ specification and enhanced with GitHub Flavored Markdown, you get all the normal Markdown goodness, plus **task lists** and **tables**. ### Multiple "Source" Folders Easily add all your notes -- maybe a set of blog posts in our Documents folder, notes for work and various projects in your Dropbox or iCloud Drive. ### HTML/CSS/Bootstrap 4 Supported Embedded HTML and CSS is also supported. For the true power user, you can utilize the embedded Bootstrap 4 framework ### "Live" Task Lists Task lists are "live" - click on the checkbox and it will be marked in the source document. Create a list of todos and check them off one by one as they get done, without having to directly edit the document. ### 1Password Integration If you use _1Password_ to store your logins to various websites, you can easily create a link to one of these sites, by simply dragging an item from 1Password into the editor window. ### Integrated Spark File An easy way to chronicle and capture thoughts or ideas through the creation of _sparks_. Each spark is stamped with a date and time and kept in chronological order, so you can quickly browse through them. ### Syntax Highlighting Embedded source code can be syntax highlighted for many languages, including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Ruby, and many more. ### Smart Drag/Drop Drag a link or an image from your browser into your text, and have it inserted as a proper link or image, including the title for the link. ### Document Aliasing Sometimes information belongs in more than one place; create an alias to virtually place a note in any section/folder where it needs to be. ### Dark Mode and Multiple Themes _Normal_, _Solarized Dark_, and _Solarized Light_ themes for display and editing are provided, or create your own customized themes, whether it's making a small tweak to an existing theme or creating something entirely new. A "Dark Mode" is also provided. ### Multiple Columns Sometimes, it makes sense to have multiple columns for your notes/data. With a simple syntax, easily create new rows and columns. Simple and unobtrusive. ## Additional Features - Markdown - Fully CommonMark compliant - Supports GitHub Flavored Markdown (GFM) extensions - Tables - Task lists - Footnotes - Supports GitLab Flavored Markdown (GFLM) extensions - Multiline blockquotes - Color chips - Inline diagrams with Kroki - Other Markdown extensions - Description lists - MathJax for TeX and LaTeX Support - Abbreviations - Syntax highlighting - Defining multiple columns - Data stored as text - Frictionless keyboard flow - Click to edit at specific location - Sharing menu integration - Export (HTML, PDF and Web Archives) - Touchbar support - Back/Forward history navigation - QuickLook integration

description: PureOpen is a Markdown editor for Mac and iPhone built for right-to-left writing. Most editors treat RTL as a switch: turn it on and the whole document flips, which breaks the moment you write Hebrew or Arabic with English words in it. PureOpen decides direction per block instead. Every paragraph, heading and list item takes its direction from the first strong character in it — so a mixed document displays correctly with no setting, and with no direction marks written into your file. Files open in tabs, the way a browser opens pages, and your changes are on disk 600ms after you stop typing. RIGHT-TO-LEFT, PER BLOCK • RTL and LTR live side by side in one file. A Hebrew paragraph aligns right, the English paragraph under it aligns left, and each stays that way as you edit. • A Hebrew or Arabic sentence with English terms, code spans and links inside it reads correctly — the block stays RTL and the Latin runs sit where they belong. • A block with no strong character inherits the direction of the block above it, so blank lines and numbers don't break the flow. • Nothing is added to your Markdown to make this work: no RTL marks, no wrapper tags. The file stays portable. OPEN IT FROM THE FILE, NOT FROM THE APP • Right-click a Markdown file in Finder — or long-press it in Files on iPhone and iPad — and PureOpen sits at the top of "Open With". One click and the document is open in a tab in the window you already have. • No launching the app first, no file picker, no importing into a library. Double-click works the same way, and so does dragging a file onto the window. • Registered as the owner and editor of .md, .markdown, .mdown and .mkd. TABS • Every file opens in its own tab. ⌘1–⌘9 jump by position, Ctrl+Tab cycles, middle-click closes, and ⌘W closes the tab rather than the window. • The tabs you had open come back the next time you launch. SAVING • Autosave writes 600ms after you stop typing, and again on tab switch, tab close and window blur. A grey dot marks a tab with unsaved content. • If the file changes on disk — another editor, a sync client — it is reloaded quietly and your scroll position is kept. If it is deleted, editing locks so stale content is not written back over it. • Opening a file doesn't reformat it: an edit that didn't actually change the content doesn't trigger a write. EDITING • 17 formatting buttons: headings 1–4, bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, bullet, numbered and task lists, subscript, superscript, quote, inline code, code block and horizontal rule. • Each button reflects the block and the marks under the cursor, and updates as the cursor moves. • Underline, subscript and superscript are kept as HTML rather than dropped when the file is saved. PRINTING AND PDF • Print what you see. The page is the document as the editor renders it — headings, tables, task lists, code blocks, Hebrew and English side by side — without the tabs and the toolbar around them. • Export the same page straight to a PDF file, without going through the print dialog to find "Save as PDF". • Nothing is rendered a second time for paper, so what prints is what you were looking at. Pages break between lines, and the page is always light even when the app is in dark mode. ALSO • On iPhone and iPad, files opened from Files are edited in place — not copied into the app. • Dark mode follows the system setting. • Files past roughly 4 million characters open read-only as raw text, so the interface doesn't stall. • No network, no account, no telemetry. Your files stay on your device. PureOpen is free, with no in-app purchases.

description: Turn PDFs into Markdown you can edit, search, and reuse. Keep headings, lists, tables, and code organized automatically. No uploads. Your documents stay on your device. PDF to Markdown Converter analyzes the text structure in a PDF and creates clean, readable Markdown. Move technical specifications, research papers, class materials, and business documents into your notes or development workflow without retyping and reformatting everything. MAIN FEATURES • Import PDFs from the Files app • Drag and drop files on supported devices • Detect headings, chapter labels, and numbered hierarchies • Convert bullet points and numbered lists • Rebuild structured content as Markdown tables • Recognize JSON, XML, SQL, Swift, JavaScript, and PHP code blocks • Format URLs automatically • Remove page numbers, separators, and common PDF noise • Generate a table of contents • Copy, share, or export the result as an .md file • Save recent conversions and reopen past results • Toggle heading, list, table, and code conversion settings • Compare the original PDF and Markdown side by side on iPad and Mac USE CASES • Move API specifications and technical documents into a README or wiki • Organize PDF notes in Obsidian or another Markdown editor • Paste structured content into Notion for further editing • Turn papers and course materials into editable research notes • Reuse archived PDF copy for writing and publishing • Preserve tables and code in portable plain text FULL APP FEATURES One purchase includes the complete app. There is no additional subscription. Conversion, history, preview, copy, sharing, and Markdown export are all included. PRIVATE BY DESIGN Every conversion runs locally on your iPhone, iPad, or Mac. Your PDFs and converted text are never uploaded to an external server, and no account or sign-in is required. Work with private specifications, reports, and research even without an internet connection. Choose a PDF, convert it to Markdown, and save it where you work. Spend less time reformatting documents and more time using their content.

description: See your Markdown the way it's meant to look. Open any README, note or doc and get a clean, formatted page: headings, tables, checklists and code, without the clutter. It opens files you already have and presents them clearly. Supports .md, .markdown, .mdown, and .mkd files. Open Markdown files from the Files app or other apps.

description: Lede is the app you want when you double-click a Markdown file. One file, one window. No sidebar, no folder tree, no library to import into. It opens the file where you keep it, shows it properly, and gives it back byte for byte. THE SYNTAX DISAPPEARS A heading reads as a heading and bold reads as bold, while the file underneath stays exactly what you typed. Lede hides the markers by what the line says, not by where your cursor is, so the text never reflows as you move through it. That last part is what the other live-preview editors get wrong. THREE VIEWS, ONE MEASURE Write has a caret. Read renders the document properly, with tables, callouts and struck-through tasks. Source shows the file the way a text editor would: monospaced, uncoloured, with line numbers. Switching between them never moves a line. A PAGE WORTH LOOKING AT Four page colours — warm Paper, White, Grey and true Black for OLED displays — applied to the whole window rather than to a panel inside it. Each carries its own ink and its own accent, measured against that page. Seven type sizes, and a line length set in characters rather than pixels, so a larger size widens the measure instead of squeezing the words. A SLASH MENU THAT TEACHES ITSELF OUT OF A JOB Type / and pick a heading, a list, a table, a callout. It shows you the Markdown it is about to write, so after a few uses you type the syntax yourself and stop opening the menu. MARKDOWN, PROPERLY 647 of 650 CommonMark examples and 666 of 672 GitHub Flavored Markdown examples, measured against the specifications' own test suites. Tables, footnotes, task lists, nested lists, code fences with highlighting. IT GIVES YOUR FILE BACK UNCHANGED Open and save, twice over, and the bytes are identical. Smart quotes and dashes are off and cannot be turned on, because rewriting your punctuation as you type breaks the one promise this app makes. If the file changes on disk while you have it open, Lede tells you and lets you choose. NOTHING LEAVES YOUR MAC No account, no server, no telemetry, no analytics. Lede checks once a day whether a newer version exists and that is the only thing it ever sends. NATIVE, AND SMALL Written in AppKit for the Mac. No Electron, no browser engine hidden inside, no JavaScript runtime. The whole app is about five megabytes and it opens immediately. Lede is free. Not free with an upgrade, not free for now: there is nothing to buy and nothing to subscribe to. From the makers of Skein.

description: FlatNote is a markdown notes app for people who want their writing to stay plain, portable, and theirs. It runs on iPhone, iPad, and Mac, and your notes sync across all of them through your own iCloud, or stay in a folder you choose. Type markdown and watch it format as you go. Headings, bold, italic, strikethrough, links, quotes, bullet lists, and tappable checkboxes all render while you write. The raw symbols stay out of your way and reappear only on the line you are editing, so you always know exactly what you typed. WHAT YOU GET - Live formatting. See the result as you type, with a one minute reference note included. - Photos in your notes. Paste an image or attach one; it is saved next to the note as an ordinary file, not in a database. - Folders, pins, and sorting. Organize notes into real directories and keep the ones you use on top. - Real checkboxes. Tap to check things off, right in the note. - Find in a note. Search the open note and jump between highlighted matches. - Quick formatting. A formatting bar above the keyboard on iPhone and iPad, and standard shortcuts on Mac. - Find your notes fast. Search the whole library by title or content. YOUR WORDS BELONG TO YOU - Every note is a plain .md file. No proprietary format, no lock-in, readable in any app, on any device, years from now. - Your notes live in your iCloud and sync across your iPhone, iPad, and Mac automatically, signed in with your Apple ID. No separate account to make. - Export carries everything. Share any note as markdown, with its pictures included, or export your whole library as one zip of ordinary files. The files are also right there in the Files app on iOS and Finder on Mac. - Delete is honest. Deleted notes go to Trash, where they can be recovered. QUIET BY DESIGN - No ads. No tracking. No analytics. Nothing about you leaves your devices and your iCloud. - Works on iPhone, iPad, and Mac, in light and dark. FlatNote keeps the format simple so you can keep your thinking clear.

description: Folio is a small, native reader for the files a working life accumulates: Markdown notes and READMEs, reStructuredText and Sphinx documentation, source code, configuration and data files, PDFs, and images. It gives them one calm library, clear typography, and room to focus, on iPhone, iPad, and Mac. READ MARKDOWN THE WAY IT WAS MEANT TO LOOK Headings, lists, tables, task lists, blockquotes, code blocks, links, and images render on a page designed for reading, in light or dark, with serif or sans-serif type, and with text size, line spacing, and page width under your control. Equations in TeX notation render offline. An outline jumps between headings, Find highlights every match, Show Source reveals the document's own text, and Share offers the source file or a PDF of the page. The HTML that READMEs use for badges, centered logos, and collapsible sections renders too. reStructuredText files render the same way, with the Sphinx signatures, version notes, and cross-references of Python's own documentation. EVERY TEXT FILE, EXACTLY AS WRITTEN JSON, YAML, TOML, XML, HTML, CSS, shell scripts, Makefiles, logs, diffs, and source code in any common language open verbatim, with tabs, indentation, and long lines preserved. Code is colored by language, with three schemes and six editable colors, or no coloring at all if you prefer. PDFS AND IMAGES, WITHOUT LEAVING THE APP PDFs open with their own outline and Find. JPEG, PNG, HEIC, GIF, TIFF, WebP, BMP, and AVIF images fit the screen and zoom smoothly. Both are viewed from your files where they are; only one opened from a link is downloaded and kept. FILES, FOLDERS, AND LINKS Open a document, browse a whole folder, drop a file into the window, or paste a link. GitHub file links and direct HTTPS links to text, PDFs, and images are saved for offline reading, and text is refreshed while you read. Private repositories work with a personal access token that stays in your device's Keychain. YOURS, AND ONLY YOURS There is no account, no analytics, no advertising, and no upload service. Documents, bookmarks, and settings stay on your device. A single switch stops documents from loading images from the web. FREE TO BEGIN, SIMPLE TO UNLOCK Read complete text documents up to 10 KB for free, and view PDFs and images without limit. Folio Plus unlocks larger documents, Export PDF, and, on Mac, Print: • Folio Plus Lifetime: a one-time purchase of $19.99 (USD) • Folio Plus Yearly: an auto-renewing subscription of $9.99 (USD) per year Both support Family Sharing. Subscriptions are charged to your Apple Account at confirmation and renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel them in your Apple Account settings. description: Skein is a notes app for people who want to keep their own files. Your vault is a folder of plain Markdown on your device or in iCloud Drive. Write it down before you lose it The app opens on a capture field. Type the thought and send it; the first line becomes the note's title and Skein files it where you told it to. No dialog, no folder picker, no naming a file before you have written anything. Find it again Search matches titles the moment you start typing and searches inside every note once the index is ready, ranked, with the matching lines and their line numbers — tap one and land on it. The Vault filters by name, by #tag or by folder in one field, and tags are real: tap one anywhere in the app to see everything carrying it. Real Markdown, properly Headings, lists, task lists, tables, footnotes, code blocks, callouts, ==highlights== and [[wikilinks]] — read cleanly and edited as text. A keyboard bar puts the things you actually reach for above the keys, including arrows that move by character and by word, and you can choose which of them appear. Type / for a command, #for a tag it already knows. Canvas Open a JSON Canvas board, move cards, connect them, colour them and write on them. The same file, the same format Obsidian writes, so a board made on the Mac opens here and back again. It keeps your writing safe Skein keeps earlier versions of a note as you edit, so you can go back to what you wrote this morning. When the same note has been changed in two places, Skein keeps both and asks — it never picks a winner quietly. Also Share text from any app straight into your vault. Four themes, including one for reading at night. Dynamic Type throughout, and full VoiceOver support. Skein does not have an account, a subscription for the basics, a server, or telemetry. Your notes never leave your device except through iCloud Drive, which is yours. Skein for Mac is a separate app on the same purchase.

Reading & writing • Use Editor, Preview, or Split View to draft and see rendered Markdown side by side. • Use Writing Assistant to refine drafts, improve wording, and turn rough ideas into clearer notes with private on-device help. • Find text within the current document. • Sort notes by title, date added, last opened, and more. • Search across your library from the sidebar. Share & export • Share notes as Markdown or plain text. • Export documents to a folder you choose in Finder. Whether you’re collecting research, drafting READMEs, or building a personal knowledge base, Folio keeps your Markdown connected, organized, searchable, and easy to revisit.

description: RetroNotes Markdown is a local-file-based app for text, voice, visual, and drawing notes. Capture ideas naturally while keeping the original content as readable Markdown and TXT files. TEXT NOTE Write in a focused three-column workspace. Text Notes are stored as Markdown and TXT files and can be found by searching titles and content. VOICE NOTE + RECALL Hold the Voice Note button, speak, then release. RetroNotes uses system speech recognition and adds the transcription to today’s Voice Note. Original audio is not kept. Recall lets you ask questions about your Voice Notes. RetroNotes searches the original records first and presents a conclusion with supporting sources when sufficient information is available. VISION NOTE Tap the RetroNotes logo and import up to nine photos or screenshots. RetroNotes extracts visible text while preserving the relative position and size of each recognised text region. DRAW NOTE Long-press the new-note button to open Draw Note. Draw freely on selectable A, B, envelope, and US paper sizes. Export drawings as SVG, PDF, PNG, or PPTX. Handwritten strokes remain editable in PowerPoint. Visually closed drawings can be filled with colour while retaining their original hand-drawn outlines. RETRODISK Use RetroDisk to transfer a file from Mac to iPhone or iPad through the Mac screen and the receiving device’s camera. RetroDisk works without Bluetooth, AirDrop, a local network, a cable, or an account-based cloud service. PAPER DISK Use Paper Disk to turn a small important file into an encrypted printable A4 PDF archive. Each page stores about 10KB. A full 1.44MB Paper Disk is about 144 pages. Paper Disk is designed for reliable personal paper recovery of small essential files, such as Markdown files, TXT files, recovery notes, and other key documents. To restore, scan every printed page. A page is confirmed after all 9 QR codes on that page are scanned. The file restores automatically when all pages are complete. Paper Disk encrypts file content before writing the encrypted data into QR codes. File name, page number, and ID are visible on paper; file content is not stored as plain text in the QR codes. LOCAL FILES Notes remain available as Markdown and TXT files. Choose where they are stored so they are easy to read, back up, move, and access outside RetroNotes. Recall uses a locally rebuildable index. Markdown and TXT files remain the primary data. The system keyboard, speech recognition, text recognition, camera, or iCloud Photos may require permission or network access. RetroNotes does not provide an account-based cloud service. RetroNotes does not include ads, analytics, tracking services, subscriptions, or in-app purchases. KEY FEATURES - Text Note for Markdown and TXT writing - Voice Note with speech transcription - Recall for Voice Notes - Conclusions with supporting sources - Vision Note for extracting text from photos and screenshots - Spatial presentation of recognised text - Draw Note with selectable paper sizes - A0–A7 and B0–B7 paper - C4, C5, C6, DL, and US #10 envelopes - Letter, Legal, and Tabloid paper - SVG, PDF, PNG, and editable PPTX export - Search for Text Notes, Vision Notes, and Draw Note titles - RetroDisk optical file transfer - Paper Disk printable file archive - Encrypted A4 PDF paper recovery - User-chosen data location - Folder-based organisation - Search highlighting - Adjustable editor text size - English and Chinese interface - Designed for iPhone, iPad, and Mac

description: Markdown, page by page. MarkRead makes AI-generated writing easier to read closely, and easier to think through. Pinch the pages into a stack and spread them out again right where you left off; switch between the two any time without losing your place. The more AI writes, the more it needs a proper read. MarkRead lays a .md file out as a calm reading page: headings, lists, quotes, code, and tables in clear order, so the point comes out fast and you decide with something solid under you. Reading in Pages • Pages, side by side See more at once and page through long reads. Up to four columns on iPad, two pages on iPhone in landscape, one to four on Mac. • Stack, then spread Gather your pages into a stack, then spread them out again, right where you left off. On iPhone and iPad, just pinch and spread. • Scroll or Pages, one tap Two ways to read the same document. Switch any time and stay on the same line. Features • Open. Start reading. Files stay on the device; what syncs goes through your own iCloud private database. On iPhone and iPad • The whole set at a glance Progress and status for every file, all in one view. On Mac • Immersive review A focused window built for deep reading and clear-headed judgment. • Drop in, start reading Drag an AI-generated .md onto the window and go straight into review. • The whole picture Outline and library on one screen—see it all, then decide. Who it's for People who read AI-generated reports, technical docs, notes, and long-form Markdown; people who move between iPhone, iPad, and Mac in the middle of a document; people who would rather keep related files in one set than hunt through folders; people who want more than one page on screen at a time. MarkRead Pro Unlocks 19 themes, Reading Sets, and reading progress across devices. Subscribe monthly (1 month) or yearly (1 year), or buy it once, and a one-time purchase never renews. Subscriptions renew automatically. You can switch one off any time in your system subscription settings, and it stops at the end of the period. Prices are shown in the App Store. description: Editorio is a Markdown editor for macOS, built with AppKit. There is no web view or JavaScript runtime. SPEED Documents open in a native editor with responsive scrolling and quick switching between source and preview. Large files use memory-mapped loading and a read-only mode when needed. SIDE BY SIDE Source and preview share one window, split by a divider you can drag. The two halves scroll together and are matched by heading, so the same passage stays in view on each side. EDITING Syntax highlighting covers Markdown and 18 other languages: Swift, Rust, Python, C, C++, Java, Go, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, SQL, JSON, YAML, TOML, LaTeX, shell and more. Return continues a list and a second Return ends it. Line numbers sit in the gutter, Control-G jumps to a line, and Command-F searches the entire file. TABS AND WINDOWS A window can hold multiple tabs. Drag them to reorder, or switch with Command-1 through Command-9. Quitting and reopening restores the tabs you left open. FILES Editorio reads and writes plain .md files. It does not insert front matter or reformat lines you did not edit. Work is saved as you type, and undo state is preserved when you reopen a document. APPEARANCE Light and dark themes follow the system appearance, or stay fixed to one. Font, size and preview width are adjustable. Full screen is supported. PRIVACY Editorio has no account, sync or analytics. It reads files you choose.

description: MultiMarkdown Converter Pro is a completely new utility from MultiMarkdown Software, designed to make using MMD even easier! Using it requires typing commands into the Terminal, such as: multimarkdown file.txt > output.html MultiMarkdown is not overly complicated, but not everyone wants to use command-line programs. Some people prefer to stick with more familiar applications, dragging and dropping files, etc. That's where MultiMarkdown Converter comes in. MMD Converter allows you to simply drag and drop text files, and it quickly converts them into the format you desire. There are no terminal commands to remember -- just check a few boxes to easily control MMD's behavior. ## Features ## * MMD v6 built-in * Multiple output file formats: * HTML 5 * EPUB 3 (including images) * LaTeX (including beamer or memoir) * Flat OpenDocument Text/OpenDocument Text * TextBundle/TextBundle Compressed * OPML * iThoughts Mind Map * Support for CriticMarkup -- track changes in your document, collaborate with others while revising documents, etc. * "Smart" typography conventions for English, Dutch, French, German, and Swedish * Batch processing of multiple files at once * No need to update MultiMarkdown yourself -- new versions of MultiMarkdown Converter will be released when MMD is modified. * Support for file transclusion -- a master file can embed content from other files for easier organization of your ideas * Easily embedded CSS, KaTeX, MathJax, or highlight.js for improved HTML output ## Why Should I Use MultiMarkdown Converter? ## If you currently use MMD in the Terminal, you may not need MMD Converter. It uses the same MMD you already know and love. You probably already appreciate the power and flexibility of command-line programs -- they can be used in ways that graphical applications can't. For many, this feature may provide an advantage over command-line programs. Additionally, MultiMarkdown Converter will be updated automatically by macOS. No need for you to remember to reinstall MMD each time a new version is released. Maybe you're new to the idea of Markdown/MultiMarkdown and want to experiment with an easy-to-use application, but you're not ready to invest in a full-featured editor such as MultiMarkdown Composer. No problem -- MMD Converter works easily alongside your favorite text editor. After you've tried out MultiMarkdown Converter Pro, please take a moment to leave a review on the App Store -- as you know, reviews are vitally important to helping new users discover great applications! Thank you!

description: md is a Markdown editor and live previewer for iPhone and iPad. Write plain Markdown, watch the finished page take shape as you type, then print it, export it, or turn a folder of chapters into a whole book. WRITE AND SEE • Edit and Preview on iPhone; on iPad, a Split view puts the source and the rendered page side by side — and the two panes scroll as one, so the passage you are reading is the paragraph you are writing. • Every file reopens in the layout you last used for it. • The preview is the printed page: one renderer draws the preview, the printout and the PDF — the same layout, set for paper. • Headings, lists, task lists, tables, quotes, code, links and images — plus footnotes, and metadata front matter (YAML or TOML) recognised and kept out of the page. • LaTeX math and mhchem chemistry, Mermaid graphs, Graphviz and PlantUML diagrams — all drawn on your device by engines built into the app. • A block of formulas tagged plot becomes a chart — curves, parametric figures and your own points, with a legend and a window you set — drawn by md itself. • Code fenced with a language is highlighted in a quiet palette that matches the page. • Paste a table straight from a spreadsheet into a csv or tsv block and md draws it — the first row the header, number columns lined up on the right. • Contents lists every heading and jumps the editor and the preview to it. Private author notes — an HTML comment on its own line whose text begins with the word note — are listed in the Notes menu and never appear in the preview, the PDF or the printout. • A live word and character count, and undo and redo, always within reach. FIND AND TYPE • Find and replace, with Replace All as a single undo. • Return continues lists, quotes and tables, and the first letter of each line and sentence is capitalized as you type. Both are switches. • On iPad, keyboard shortcuts for the layouts, Find, Print and the book. PRINT AND EXPORT • Print or export real A4 pages — or A5, US Letter, US Legal, or a paperback trim size for a book bound for print. Breaks fall between lines, and \newpage starts a fresh page wherever you decide. • Export as HTML: one self-contained file that opens anywhere, diagrams as drawings and formulas as real, selectable text. • Export as LaTeX: a .tex file where your mathematics stays mathematics, ready to paste into a paper. • Export a diagram or a plot as a standalone .svg vector, or the whole document — or a single one — as a standard EPUB 3. • Share the rendered PDF, share the Markdown source, or open and export TextBundle and TextPack, the Markdown-with-images container. WRITER MODE: BOOKS • A book is simply a folder: its subfolders are chapters, its Markdown files are articles, ordered by name. Start one from the opening screen, or open a folder you already have. • Tap an article to write, tap another to move on. Rename, reorder or delete a row and the order is written back to the file names, so it stays true in Files. • Compile the whole book into one PDF at the page size you choose, or export it as a standard EPUB 3 with a proper table of contents — math and diagrams travel with it as images. FILES YOU CAN KEEP • Your documents are ordinary text files — .md, .markdown and every other Markdown spelling, or .txt — kept where you choose, on your device or in your own iCloud Drive, in the encoding they arrived in. • md also opens PlantUML, Graphviz, TextBundle and TextPack files. Built-in examples, including a small sample book, show everything the app can do. PRIVATE BY DESIGN • No accounts, no sign-in, no analytics, no tracking, no ads. • Everything is rendered on your device. The only thing md fetches from the network is an image your own document points at by URL. Written in Swift and SwiftUI. The only outside code is the open-source engines that draw math, chemistry, diagrams and code — KaTeX, mhchem, Mermaid, Graphviz, PlantUML and highlight.js — bundled in and run on your device. The source code is public.

description: Quirely is two full editors in one native app: real Markdown and real LaTeX. Neither is a bolt-on. If you only ever write Markdown, you get a complete, beautiful Markdown app — nothing hidden behind TeX. If you live in LaTeX, you get a genuine editor that compiles your projects — not a Markdown app with math sprinkled in. A CALMER READER Open a file and just read. Quirely renders clean, typographic Markdown — never forcing a split screen or a cramped editor when all you want is the page. Switch to Code, Edit, or Split only when you choose. Quick Look previews .md and .tex straight from Finder. MARKDOWN, RENDERED RIGHT - Mermaid diagrams: flowcharts, sequence diagrams, and more — live, and styled to your theme. - LaTeX math: inline and block equations, typeset beautifully. - Code blocks with syntax highlighting for dozens of languages. - Tables, task lists, footnotes, callouts, full GitHub-flavored Markdown. EDIT LIKE A PRO - Four modes: View, Code, Edit (block editor), and Split. - Word-processor formatting: bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, highlight, links, super/subscript — with theme-aware colors. - Drag-and-drop block editing: reorder paragraphs, lists, tables, and diagrams by hand. - Visual Mermaid editing: drag nodes, add edges, recolor — no syntax required. - Spreadsheet functions in tables: =SUM(A1:A3), =AVERAGE, =IF and more, with a full function keypad on Mac. - Collaborate over bonjour. Share a workspace or document and each collaborator can edit with their own cursor and view. Entirely private; no external servers A REAL LATEX EDITOR - Open and compile .tex — single files or full projects with a root document, chapters, and BibTeX. - The same four modes: read the typeset PDF, edit raw source with themed syntax highlighting, or use structured Edit mode — rendered paragraphs, equations, and tables you double-click to edit. - Chapters open inline in the root document and save back to their own files. - Tabular grid editor with the same spreadsheet formulas as Markdown tables. - SyncTeX jump between source and PDF; rendered diffs between versions (latexdiff). - Export LaTeX to PDF, HTML, or clean Markdown — cite/ref/figure numbering intact. - LaTeX stays classic black-and-white by default; apply your theme with one toggle. FEYNMAN DIAGRAMS Build QED/QCD diagrams visually — vertices, propagators, gauge bosons, loops — or paste tikz-feynman. Quirely renders them natively and derives the amplitude iℳ from the Feynman rules; edit the equation and get the diagram back. Free on every tier. MAKE IT YOURS Ten hand-tuned themes recolor every token — headings, code, links, tables, diagrams. Duplicate any theme and edit every color, font, and size. Switch live. A REAL WORKSPACE - Open a folder with file navigation, backlinks, and tabs. - Semantic search and exact full-text search. - Version history with rendered diffs. - Mark positions to insert text across documents. ON-DEVICE AI (Pro) Draft, rewrite, and synthesize across your notes with Apple Intelligence — on-device, no API fees, no account. EXPORT & SHARE Polished HTML or paginated PDF with your theme, math, and diagrams intact. PRIVATE BY DESIGN Everything runs on your device. Your files stay plain Markdown and LaTeX you own — no account, no lock-in. ONE APP, EVERY DEVICE Universal for Mac, iPad, and iPhone. One-time purchases — never a subscription. Write in Markdown or LaTeX. Read either beautifully.

description: Scriptum for iPhone is the reading half of the Mac Markdown editor. Write on the Mac, and the document is waiting on your phone, rendered the same way you left it. OPEN IT ON THE MAC, READ IT LATER ON YOUR PHONE Switch on iPhone sync in Scriptum for Mac and every document you open there is kept in your own iCloud account, ready on your phone. The library groups files by day, newest first, so the thing you were just working on is at the top. Nothing to export, no copy to email yourself, no separate service to sign up for. RENDERED, NOT RAW Markdown on a phone usually means either plain text or a stripped-down preview. Scriptum renders the whole document: - LaTeX math with KaTeX, inline and as centered display equations - Mermaid diagrams drawn on the device, so flowcharts and sequence diagrams stay sharp at any size. Tap one to fill the screen and pinch to zoom - Syntax highlighting for Swift, Python, JavaScript, Go, Rust, SQL and more - Tables that wrap to fit the screen instead of making you pan sideways - Task lists, footnotes, GitHub alerts, highlights, definition lists TWO WAYS TO READ Standard View keeps the structure visible: colored headings, rules, the shape of a technical document at a glance. Article View turns the same file into something closer to a book page. Headings drop back to reading ink, the column narrows to a comfortable measure, and the line height opens up. Warm paper in light mode, deep ground in dark. Both follow your system appearance, or you can pin light or dark. Text size is adjustable, and every document remembers where you stopped reading. FINDING THINGS Search inside the rendered document with the system find bar. Share the original Markdown file from any document, unchanged and still plain text. WHAT THIS APP IS This first release is a reader. Writing and editing live on the Mac, where the keyboard is. The phone is for the other times: on the train, in a meeting, away from the desk, when you need to look something up in a spec or a set of notes you already wrote. More is on the way. Editing on the phone, iPad support and offline handling are all in progress, and this app updates alongside the Mac one. ONE PURCHASE Scriptum is a single app across Mac and iPhone. If you already own it on the Mac, the iPhone version is included at no extra cost, and buying here includes the Mac editor too. One payment, no subscription. Requires an iCloud account to receive documents from your Mac.
